name: k8s node dead-man — poweredge-xubuntu kubelet usage silent 20 min
description: Fires when ZERO k8s.node.cpu.usage datapoints for k8s.node.name=poweredge-xubuntu arrive in the trailing 20 min (evaluated every 10 min). The poweredge-xubuntu collector scrapes every node's kubelet every 30 s, so silence means the node, its kubelet, the API-server proxy, the k8s_observer/receiver_creator pair, or the poweredge collector is down — the cluster is being flown blind for that node. UNGROUPED BUT FILTERED to one node, as every dead-man here: a grouped query cannot fire on a silent subject. Emitter: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml on poweredge-xubuntu. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes node load' board; ssh <node>; mpstat 5 3; free -g; kubectl describe node <node>; kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-uftb4o.
